reading_note: Buildings only, scored binary: unlabelled pixels count as not-building. SpaceNet 7 annotates buildings and nothing else, so this says NOTHING about road, vegetation, water or bare land performance on Indian sites -- those remain unmeasured. It is also 0.5 m satellite imagery, not drone capture, so it speaks for building extraction at satellite scale rather than for a survey flown at 60 m. Compare predicted_building_fraction against labelled_building_fraction: a model predicting far more building than exists is over-segmenting, which the multiclass metric on this holdout cannot show at all.
